{{if and .cdn_ack .cdn_ack.cancel_cdn}}### CDN Cancelled

You cancelled this Cargo Dispatch Note (CDN) while it waited for Customs to acknowledge it, so this container's dispatch has ended in the Single Window. The CDN stays registered in ASYCUDA World until Customs cancels it there.

* **Status**: Cancelled{{else}}{{if .cdn_ack}}{{if eq (print .cdn_ack.ack_status) "CANCELLED"}}### ❌ CDN Cancelled

Sri Lanka Customs cancelled this Cargo Dispatch Note (CDN) in ASYCUDA World, so it will not be acknowledged. This container's dispatch has ended, and another CDN cannot be raised for it.

* **Status**: Cancelled{{else}}### ✅ CDN Acknowledged

Your Cargo Dispatch Note (CDN) has been acknowledged by Customs.

* **Status**: Acknowledged{{end}}{{else}}### Wait on CDN Acknowledgement

Your Cargo Dispatch Note (CDN) has been submitted successfully to Customs. It is currently pending acknowledgement.

Once Customs acknowledges the CDN, the Single Window will receive the confirmation and this step will advance. You do not need to take any action.

* **Status**: Pending acknowledgement{{end}}{{end}}{{with .submission}}
